reviews.text: I took my hamster for a checkup. He's an excellent vet, friendly, kind, and helpful. He's definitely a reference point ☺️
Great professionalism and deep love, the winning combination. Thank you, Dr. Luca.
I went to this clinic for the first time and I had a great experience. The doctor is excellent. I will gladly return and he will be my vet from now on.

Good morning everyone, I recently took my dog ​​Vichi to Dr. Re and I was really happy because they are serious, loving, meticulous patients in their examinations, visits, etc. They have so much love for animals, I recommend them, they are professional.

Very friendly and knowledgeable staff
Fair prices
He will be our trusted vet for all our reptiles!

In all your years of experience, we could have simply said it was inoperable tumor, instead you operated on it, it extended to my bunny, she couldn't take it and now I'm devastated, you just wanted to bill me, in my opinion, thank you very much, I understand, However, in your years of experience, you should have said that surgery couldn't be done AND THAT'S IT and I would have gone home!!! That it was too risky, you shouldn't have intervened, you are still responsible!!!

I brought my little lovebird, Bimba, for a broken leg. Dr. Luca Re literally saved her life with surgery. Everyone was wonderful, kind, and professional, from Dr. Luca Re to all his staff. Fantastic veterinary clinic, my sincerest compliments!!! Highly recommended ❤️

I took my cat Benny to be spayed and I have to say that both Dr. Luca Re and Dr. Arianna were fantastic. Professional, kind, and truly attentive. Benny was treated very well and they explained everything to me simply and clearly. Thank you so much, you're a top team!
Gabriella and Benny

I've been to them a couple of times for my cat's vaccinations and I've been very satisfied. Dr. Robba in particular was extremely kind and clear. It was a real pleasure meeting her and having had an exam with her!
Exceptional! Experts in exotic animals with great experience and humanity.
I've been here a couple of times for my Scottish and have been looked after by almost all the staff, they are very kind and really good! I highly recommend it.

This afternoon I took my 9-year-old lop-eared rabbit to this veterinary practice for a fairly significant jaw swelling and other issues. I don't believe Dr. Re examined him because, reading the reviews, it doesn't seem like he's the same person who examined my rabbit today. The fact is, as soon as I entered, the doctor told me that the rabbit's condition was considered animal abuse. I should point out that I've never had rabbits, but only rescued dogs. I have two, currently 9 years old. Choppy also reached 9 years old, but according to him, everything I've done up until now has been counterproductive for the animal, from the food to the various hygiene habits. (I was told that if it had been a car, he would have told me to scrap it.) And I don't know if this means anything, but one of the three died 2 years ago at the age of 20. So even though I may have made a mistake with my little one (which only this doctor said, but anyone who knows me knows), it's not nice to hear something like that because you've psychologically destroyed someone who's already been through a lot. After all,
someone like me who loves all animals regardless and without distinction. I just hope my little choppy gets better, even if, from what the doctor told me, he won't be the same again.
I just ask you for a little more humanity, because you never know how a person treated this way might react upon leaving.

An exceptional vet! Kind, competent, and always available. He treated my cat with great care and professionalism, explaining every step clearly. Thanks to him, my little one is doing great! Highly recommended to anyone looking for a true professional who loves animals. 🐱❤️ …
First visit, I had a great experience with Dr. Robba: she was kind in her approach to my cat and thorough in her examination. Being able to book online was very convenient.
The best. Here, expertise combines with a rare sensitivity: you enter with concern in your heart and leave with the feeling that the treatment has already begun.
The vets at the clinic are simply magnificent. I cared for two rabbits there years ago and now two guinea pigs, and the care is extraordinary.
The doctors at the clinic are top-notch professionals, very humane. They treated my elderly cat (including surgery) and everything went perfectly. Recommended ❣️
Very knowledgeable and always available for my bunny. I highly recommend them to anyone who has other pets.

A team of trained, kind, and attentive veterinarians. They are excellent even with animals who are a bit reluctant to come to the vet. Having multiple doctors can sometimes be problematic because, naturally, they have differing opinions, which complicates treatment for long-term problems. N.B.: Appointments are required.
Wonderful, friendly, helpful and above all prepared!
Our bunny was sterilized 4 days ago and she is doing an amazing job even now. Thank you, definitely recommend!

Dr. Re was recommended to me by my vet here in Switzerland for a serious dental problem that had been discovered in Biscotto, my dwarf lop-eared rabbit.
Besides being very kind and professional, Dr. Re was also very honest: after extensive investigations and after verifying that Biscotto's general health was excellent, he didn't push for surgery, but advised us to wait and see how the situation evolves. I assure you, this isn't a given. If and when Biscotto needs surgery, I'll know who to entrust him to. Thank you, Dr. Re!

IF YOU DON'T LIVE IN THE AREA, IT'S NOT WORTH IT.
Attracted by the reputation and positive reviews of this clinic, I decided to book an appointment for my two rats, even though it's a 30-40 minute drive from my house. I found the number, called, and... you can only book online. I booked online and clicked "add event to calendar." So far, so good. On the day of the appointment, since I hadn't received any confirmation of my appointment, I tried calling: the receptionist. So I went there and waited. No receptionist, no one to speak to. At a certain point, I realized that the "save to calendar" option had marked a completely different day, and my appointment had already passed (it wasn't my mistake because automatically added appointments are color-coded differently than those added manually). I waited 30 minutes and finally managed to meet with the vet, who told me he didn't have time and that we could reschedule for another day. Unfortunately, it's not easy for me to take at least two hours to go through this whole ordeal again. I don't question the professionalism and kindness of the vets, but I find the lack of services and organization quite disappointing. In short, the center advertises itself as specialized for exotic animals and seemingly full of resources, but in reality it's a small neighborhood practice with no receptionist and only one vet at a time, making it rightfully difficult to handle every eventuality and, I imagine, manage the backlog of appointments.
Despite all this, my rats came home exhausted and covered in their own feces, given the stress of the trip and the long wait.
Disappointing.
We had a great time.

We've been bringing our three budgies, Romeo, Pandora, and Arturo, to Dr. Re's office for at least a couple of years. Over the years, they've been seen several times by Dr. Re, Dr. Pedrazzini, Dr. Del Gaudio, and Dr. Bardi. Everyone has …
Dr. Re is a great professional and a wonderful person. I've been trusting him for a long time now, and he has a rare sensitivity. Thank you, Doctor, truly.

It was a great experience! My leopard gecko's visit was quick but very thorough. It's clear that the doctor is very experienced and listened to all my concerns without rushing me. I would definitely come back to have my exotic pets examined.
